frequency_question: How often do proposed central tax rate rationalizations or service inclusion clarifications backed by the primary fiscal principals result in formal council approval within a two-year window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal agenda items proposed by the federal-state joint tax council involving sector-specific service tax clarifications or rate adjustments where the dominant ministerial principals expressed intent to harmonize or close loopholes. Excludes items dropped entirely before formal discussion due to lack of executive consensus.
